mesh.generation: structured boxes split into six conforming linear tetrahedra per cube; quadratic edge nodes shared by endpoint pair
mesh.refinement_scope: longitudinal x only; one cube across each transverse direction is retained

model.mass: consistent TET10 mass matrix assembled by GlobalAssembler
model.boundary_conditions: all UX, UY, UZ fixed on the complete x=0 face

load.type: nodal force at the center node of the x=L face
load.time_function: piecewise-linear triangular pulse; zero at t=0, peak 1 at T1/8, returns to zero at T1/4, then remains zero

reference.spatial_operator: same M and K assembled by GlobalAssembler from the same TET10 model
reference.method: generalized symmetric eigen-decomposition and matrix exponential on each affine load segment; does not reuse Newmark recurrence
reference.duration: two first-mode periods for each mesh
reference.modal_route_comparison: one coarse-mesh full-order modal_newmark run at 32 steps per first-mode period
reference.limitations: verifies temporal integration against the semidiscrete model, not TET10 spatial accuracy against a continuum or external solver

criteria.formal_acceptance_thresholds: none; temporal errors, tail-energy variation, frequency increments and mesh effects are descriptive
structural_invariants: probe remains at the fixed physical face-center coordinate
full modal basis is used in the modal route comparison
criteria.spatial_study_limit: two axial levels with one transverse cell each; not a convergence qualification

execution.semantics: wall/output limits are enforced by the runner; RSS/process/temp/archive are sampled monitors and not OS quotas
